title: Spike the Gemini Live API for Customer discovery
objective: Learn whether a live voice channel is viable for Customer search before E3 commits to an architecture around it.
acceptance_criteria: the spike answers the question it was scoped to ask, in writing
the throwaway code is thrown away, or an ADR explains why it stays
latency and cost are recorded, because those are what decide it
notes: FREE TIER CONFIRMED TO CARRY THE LIVE API, from the founder's AI Studio rate-limit page on 2026-08-05. Three models are available with unlimited requests per minute and a real token budget: Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio Dialog (1M tokens/min), Gemini 3 Flash Live (65K), Gemini 3.5 Live Translate (20K). Veo 3 and Veo 3 Lite read 0/0 and are NOT available. So this is a working spike rather than a written assessment, and the constraint to design against is tokens per minute, not request count — the opposite of the 15-requests-per-minute limit that shapes every other Gemini call in this repository. FOUNDER AUTHORISED FREE TIER ONLY: stop and report rather than calling any paid tier. Native Audio Dialog has by far the largest budget and is the one to start with. Explicitly throwaway. A spike that quietly becomes production is the failure mode; say so in the report rather than leaving it to be discovered. Phase 2 work — the coordinator should not assign it while Phase 1 tasks are open unless the founder asks.
